rationale: This is a near-cosmetic re-specification of the archive's strongest gen-0 signal (same two legs, MUL→SUMRANK, IND_RANK dropped), and both legs are individually well-known published anomalies (asset/PP&E growth and share issuance), so the incremental learning is limited to an operator choice rather than a new economic mechanism.

target_name: Investment intensity signed by funding source
rationale: The expression is internally inconsistent with its hypothesis — multiplying a signed z-score by SIGN(net financing) sends low-investment/self-funded firms (discipline) into the short leg and low-investment/external-raiser firms (cash burners) into the long leg, and low-investment firms do not cluster near zero as claimed since only average-investment firms do.

target_name: Payout share of total capital uses
rationale: A cleanly bounded, well-motivated allocation-mix ratio that usefully tests the positive-sign side, though it is essentially a monotone blend of two heavily documented anomalies (payout yield and investment/asset growth) and its unguarded prstkc/dvc terms (unlike the COALESCE'd aqc) plus a possible zero denominator for no-deployment firms may bite coverage.

target_name: Chronic capital market dependence with heavy investment
rationale: The frequency-versus-magnitude contrast against the archived cumulative-buildout signal is a legitimate and diagnostic distinction, but the financing leg takes only four discrete values so its rank is mostly ties and the composite will be dominated by the (already well-known) investment-rate leg.

The working-capital funding channel is genuinely absent from this archive and both tails are interpretable, but total-liability growth is nearly collinear with balance-sheet asset growth and inventory change is a documented anomaly (Thomas–Zhang), so the composite risks being a repackaging of asset growth plus accruals rather than a new interaction.

Extending the financing interaction to labor commitment brings a data channel and real-side mechanism not present in the archive with coherent long and short tails, though both legs are published anomalies on their own (hiring rate; net external financing), the additive SUMRANK form tests co-occurrence rather than true conditioning, and emp coverage/staleness should be watched.
